name: conductor
description: Conductor worker pack: 4 subagents (planning, research, implement, code-review) for the baton:conductor orchestrator. The orchestrator, the context7 MCP server and the git-diff and okf-memory skills come from the baton dependency. Subagents work through the job-file protocol in .claude/conductor/jobs/<job-id>/; the orchestrator is the only agent that talks to you and keeps the project's .claude/agent-memory/baton-conductor/ Obsidian vault. Run /baton:setup to enable the Task tools (CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS) in the project's .claude/settings.json.
